I fixed the percent discount in `src/cart.js`, but I haven't run the tests. The test command needed approval and I didn't retry it.

**Bug:** `SAVE10` took 10% of each item's unit price and never multiplied by `qty`. Any line with quantity above 1 was under-discounted. For example, 3 × $20 got $2 off instead of $6. Rounding each item separately could also be off by a cent or more.

**Fix:** `discount()` now takes the percentage of the whole subtotal and rounds once: `Math.round((subtotal(items) * rule.value) / 100)`. `FLAT5` was already correct.

If your existing tests assumed the old per-item rounding, one might fail, so run `npm test` to check. I didn't add a test for the multi-quantity case.
